bagPolicy.summary: Dolby Live at Park MGM does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at Dolby Live at Park MGM can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: Dolby Live at Park MGM does not publish a permanent rideshare location for every event. Follow event-day traffic signs and confirm the active pickup point in your rideshare app.

concessions.note: Outside food is not permitted inside Dolby Live. Beverage service and event concessions vary by performance; Park MGM also offers multiple restaurants elsewhere in the resort.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: To guarantee a wheelchair or scooter, please contact our Bell Desk at 702.730.7290

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Dolby Live at Park MGM's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Dolby Live at Park MGM. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Dolby Live at Park MGM. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
